_about: Example Wasabi config with the Malkuth Software tools. Copy to ~/.sushi/wasabi.json (all projects) or <project>/.sushi/wasabi.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

stdin_wait._remote_wrappers: m4ws <workspace> <command...> and m4run <workspace> [options] -- <command...> run the command on the M4 through ssh, joining the words with spaces, with stdin forwarded.

shared_tree._trees: The coordinator clone is also a Codex agent's working folder (memory shared-coordinator-clone.md): never switch, stash, clean, reset or commit there. Per-clone marking with `wasabi.py mark-shared` works too and uses the general rules.

~/Developer/gui_forms.note: Do coordinator git work in a separate clone or a worker workspace.
